subject: general
question: Sambhar Lake is situated in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __Rajasthan__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sambhar Lake is India’s largest inland salt lake located near Jaipur, Rajasthan.__
 
• The lake is surrounded on all sides by the Aravali hills. 
 
• Sambhar Lake has been designated as a Ramsar site in 1990 because the wetland is a key wintering area for tens of thousands of flamingos and other birds that migrate from northern Asia.
 
• The specialized algae and bacteria growing in the lake provide striking watercolours and support the lake ecology that, in turn, sustains the migrating waterfowl.
